S1: He's read his slides twenty times. Silently. In his head. Flawless.
S2: Next morning, he opens his mouth... and nothing comes out.
His brain knew the words. His mouth had never met them.
S3: Reading in your head and saying it out loud are different skills.
You only get better at the one you actually practise.
S4: So rehearse out loud. Standing up. Three times. Once to a friend.
The first run will sound terrible. That's the run that counts.
S5: Send this to the friend reading their slides on the train.
